title: Aspectual Se & Completeness
goal: Use aspectual se with verbs of consuming, learning and reading to mark completeness
grammar: se-aspectual with definite or quantified objects

items: I can use aspectual *se* (*comerse*, *tomarse*, *leerse*, *saberse*) with whole, definite or quantified objects.
I can avoid aspectual *se* with bare, unquantified nouns like *pan* or *agua*.
I can use everyday expressions of completeness like *de un trago*, *de una sentada* and *de memoria*.
